method: Author reconciliation of actual-audio model reports; no human listening claim. All fourteen full reports and fifty-six focused reports were parsed and retained without suppressing concerns.

name_pronunciation.finding: Reviews of excerpts containing the name describe recognizable Carol/Carole pronunciation in both languages. Non-occurrence of the name or BHW in other excerpts is not a defect. No target speech alias was added.

unresolved_concerns.finding: Full reports often describe a consistent narrator, while focused excerpts identify timbre/pitch shifts, sometimes label voices male/female or treat transitions as planned characters. Character or multi-speaker switching was not intended: the generator uses the same target-only female Kore style for every sentence. These disagreements remain unresolved, rather than being dismissed as normal prosody.
